name: Williams-Sonoma
description: Williams-Sonoma designs its own home furnishings and cookware under brands such as Pottery Barn, West Elm and Williams Sonoma and sells them through its own websites, catalogues and 506 stores, plus a business-to-business division for hospitality and commercial buyers. Because it designs and sells under its own labels, it earns an unusually high 18.1 percent operating margin for a home retailer (FY2025 operating income $1.42 billion on $7.8 billion of revenue). It reports one segment. Revenue was up 1.2 percent and operating income down 1 percent as tariffs raised costs; it returned about $1.2 billion to shareholders through $854 million of buybacks and $327 million of dividends.

gics.note: Wikipedia list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry were not in a source read, so left null.

employees.note: About 19,800 associates, a mix of full-time, part-time and seasonal (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Pottery Barn
businessLines.how: Own-designed furniture and decor sold at full price online and in stores, largely made to order by contract manufacturers, with design and brand as the margin source.

businessLines.name: West Elm
businessLines.how: Same own-brand model aimed at younger, urban buyers.

businessLines.name: Williams Sonoma (incl. Williams Sonoma Home)
businessLines.how: Sells cookware and kitchen goods, a mix of own-label and third-party brands, at retail.
businessLines.description: Cookware, kitchen tools, food and home; 152 stores

businessLines.name: Pottery Barn Kids and Teen
businessLines.how: Own-brand furniture and bedding for families, often replaced as children age.
businessLines.description: Children and teen furniture and bedding; 44 Kids stores

businessLines.name: Other (Rejuvenation, Mark and Graham, GreenRow)
businessLines.description: Lighting and hardware (13 Rejuvenation stores), personalised gifts and the newest brand
